biotools.summary: Aggrescan4D (A4D) is a web server for predicting pH-dependent protein aggregation and engineering protein solubility. It builds on the A3D method, offering evolutionary-informed mutation protocols and integrating precalculated results and structure retrieval from AlphaFold.
